products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS is a nonprofit organization that operates Lmarena.ai, a public platform it describes as an AI ranking and LLM leaderboard. The site invites users to chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across text, image, and code categories, with the stated aim of building a crowdsourced, real-world evaluation leaderboard for the broader AI research community. The platform notes that user conversations and certain personal information may be shared with relevant AI providers or disclosed publicly to support research.

The organization's tracked product, listed under the Chat and General LLMs category, is the LMSYS Arena Models platform, characterized as a model evaluation and crowdsourced benchmarking tool intended for research transparency rather than production use. No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with LMSYS in the held facts.
